name: Paolo Maldini
title: The art of belonging
bio: A one-club career defined by defensive intelligence and leadership.
moment: Captaining Milan to the 2007 European title.

name: Franco Baresi
title: The quiet authority
bio: A libero whose reading of the game helped shape Milan’s defensive identity.
moment: Leading the defence in the European triumphs of 1989 and 1990.

name: Kaká
title: Grace at full speed
bio: A Brazilian attacking midfielder remembered for powerful runs and elegant finishing.
moment: The 2007 European campaign and Ballon d’Or.

name: Andrea Pirlo
title: A different kind of time
bio: A deep-lying playmaker who made patience and passing range a creative weapon.
moment: Orchestrating midfield in the 2003 and 2007 European-winning teams.

name: Clarence Seedorf
title: Intelligence in motion
bio: A technically gifted Dutch midfielder with a rare feel for the rhythm of elite matches.
moment: European success with Milan in 2003 and 2007.

name: Andriy Shevchenko
title: An instinct for the moment
bio: The Ukrainian forward combined direct running with remarkable composure in front of goal.
moment: The decisive penalty in the 2003 European final shootout.

name: Marco van Basten
title: Football as an art form
bio: A Dutch striker whose control and finishing made him an emblem of an extraordinary era.
moment: Scoring twice in the 1989 European Cup final.
